notes: Both articles of בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה are unrepresented; the written demonstrative זֶה is what the single determiner *this* realizes, under rule 41's limit that a present morpheme takes the determiner before the article does.
The two suffixes are rendered differently by the ASV — *of it* and *thereof* — and each takes what is written for it; the *of it* follows rule 19's *of + pronoun* reading, headed on the pronoun.
בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם is rendered *at even*: the preposition takes *at* and the article is unrepresented, no *the* being written.
